This should look like the female counterpart in the same illustrated character catalogue.

Cream full-length work tank top, dark blue-grey denim utility shorts reaching the upper/mid thigh, and sturdy scuffed brown lace-up work boots with flat soles. Clothes are practical and opaque. Keep the warm cream/denim/leather palette of the male base.

Keep the framing and apparent scale close to image 1. Genuine transparent background; no opaque black/white fill, vignette, glow, ground, platform, shadow behind or below the character.
